# Build Padavan cho Newifi 3 D2 (Tích hợp sẵn sing-box-lite & AdGuardHome vào ROM)
name: 新三NEWIFI3

on: 
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
env:
  TZ: Asia/Shanghai
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Initialization environment
      env:
        DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get -y install unzip libtool-bin curl cmake gperf gawk flex bison nano xxd fakeroot \
        cpio git python3-docutils gettext automake autopoint texinfo build-essential help2man \
        pkg-config zlib1g-dev libgmp3-dev libmpc-dev libmpfr-dev libncurses5-dev libltdl-dev wget

    - name: Install UPX
      uses: crazy-max/ghaction-upx@v3
      with:
        version: v4.2.4
        install-only: true

    - name: Clone source code
      env:
        KERNEL: 3.4
      run: |
        git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git /opt/rt-n56u
        cd /opt/rt-n56u/toolchain-mipsel
        sh dl_toolchain.sh
        mkdir -p /opt/images/
        
        ##### CẤU HÌNH PHÂN VÙNG BỘ NHỚ CHUẨN (Storage 2MB để dành 29.7MB cho ROM)
        sed -i 's/^CONFIG_MTD_STORE_PART_SIZ=.*/CONFIG_MTD_STORE_PART_SIZ=0x200000/' /opt/rt-n56u/trunk/configs/boards/NEWIFI3/kernel-3.4.x.config
        sed -i 's/size_etc="[0-9]*M"/size_etc="6M"/g' /opt/rt-n56u/trunk/user/scripts/dev_init.sh
        sed -i 's/mtd_part_size=[0-9]*/mtd_part_size=2097152/g' /opt/rt-n56u/trunk/user/scripts/mtd_storage.sh

        ##### WIFI: 5GHz mặc định US -> CN
        sed -i 's/\(DEF_WLAN_5G_CC[[:space:]]*\)"US"/\1"CN"/' /opt/rt-n56u/trunk/user/shared/defaults.h

    - name: Fix dosfstools timestamps + add CAKE (sch_cake, iproute2 5.12.0)
      run: |
        set -e
        R=/opt/rt-n56u/trunk

        ##### /tmp = 250M cho RAM 512MB
        sed -i 's/size_tmp="[0-9]*M"/size_tmp="250M"/' $R/user/scripts/dev_init.sh
        grep -n 'size_tmp' $R/user/scripts/dev_init.sh

        ##### Fix dosfstools
        D=$R/user/dosfstools/dosfstools-4.2
        if [ -d "$D" ]; then
          touch $D/aclocal.m4; sleep 1
          touch $D/configure $D/config.h.in 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1
          find $D -name Makefile.in -exec touch {} +
        fi

        ##### CAKE: mượn sch_cake.c + iproute2 5.12.0
        git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/TW641/padavan-ng /tmp/tw
        T=/tmp/tw/trunk
        [ -d /tmp/sch_cake ] || git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/TW641/sch_cake /tmp/sch_cake
        PORT="/tmp/sch_cake/Padavan 3.4.113"
        for h in sch_cake.c cobalt_compat.h pkt_sched.h; do
          if [ -f "$PORT/$h" ]; then cp -f "$PORT/$h" $R/linux-3.4.x/net/sched/$h; fi
        done

        cat > /tmp/cake_compat_block.h <<'CEOF'
        #include <linux/random.h>
        #include <linux/mm.h>
        #include <linux/slab.h>
        #include <linux/vmalloc.h>
        #include <linux/ip.h>
        #include <linux/ipv6.h>
        #include <linux/in.h>

        #if KERNEL_VERSION(3, 8, 0) > LINUX_VERSION_CODE
        #define prandom_u32() random32()
        #endif

        #if KERNEL_VERSION(3, 15, 0) > LINUX_VERSION_CODE
        static inline void kvfree(const void *addr)
        {
            if (is_vmalloc_addr(addr)) vfree(addr);
            else kfree(addr);
        }
        #endif

        #if KERNEL_VERSION(3, 8, 0) > LINUX_VERSION_CODE
        static inline bool cake_flow_dissect(const struct sk_buff *cskb, __be32 *src,
                                             __be32 *dst, __be32 *ports, u8 *ip_proto)
        {
            struct sk_buff *skb = (struct sk_buff *)cskb;
            int off;
            u8 proto;
            *src = 0; *dst = 0; *ports = 0; *ip_proto = 0;

            if (skb->protocol == htons(ETH_P_IP)) {
                const struct iphdr *iph;
                if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, skb_network_offset(skb) + sizeof(*iph))) return false;
                iph = ip_hdr(skb);
                *src = iph->saddr; *dst = iph->daddr;
                proto = iph->protocol;
                off = skb_network_offset(skb) + iph->ihl * 4;
                if (iph->frag_off & htons(IP_MF | IP_OFFSET)) proto = 0;
            } else if (skb->protocol == htons(ETH_P_IPV6)) {
                const struct ipv6hdr *ip6;
                if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, skb_network_offset(skb) + sizeof(*ip6))) return false;
                ip6 = ipv6_hdr(skb);
                *src = ip6->saddr.s6_addr32[0] ^ ip6->saddr.s6_addr32[1] ^ ip6->saddr.s6_addr32[2] ^ ip6->saddr.s6_addr32[3];
                *dst = ip6->daddr.s6_addr32[0] ^ ip6->daddr.s6_addr32[1] ^ ip6->daddr.s6_addr32[2] ^ ip6->daddr.s6_addr32[3];
                proto = ip6->nexthdr;
                off = skb_network_offset(skb) + sizeof(*ip6);
            } else return false;

            *ip_proto = proto;
            switch (proto) {
            case IPPROTO_TCP:
            case IPPROTO_UDP:
            case IPPROTO_UDPLITE:
            case IPPROTO_SCTP:
            case IPPROTO_DCCP:
                if (pskb_may_pull(skb, off + 4)) *ports = *(__be32 *)(skb->data + off);
                break;
            }
            return true;
        }
        #define skb_flow_dissect(skb, keys) \
            cake_flow_dissect((skb), &(keys)->src, &(keys)->dst, &(keys)->ports, &(keys)->ip_proto)
        #endif
        CEOF

        cat > /tmp/cake_hdr_patch.py <<'PEOF'
        p = "/opt/rt-n56u/trunk/linux-3.4.x/net/sched/cobalt_compat.h"
        s = open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape").read()
        if "cake_flow_dissect" not in s:
            blk = open("/tmp/cake_compat_block.h", encoding="utf-8").read()
            i = s.rindex("#endif")
            s = s[:i] + blk + s[i:]
            open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape").write(s)
        PEOF
        python3 /tmp/cake_hdr_patch.py

        for f in $T/linux-3.4.x/net/sched/*; do
          b=$(basename "$f")
          if [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -e "$R/linux-3.4.x/net/sched/$b" ]; then cp -f "$f" "$R/linux-3.4.x/net/sched/$b"; fi
        done
        grep -q TCA_CAKE_ $R/linux-3.4.x/include/linux/pkt_sched.h || cp -f $T/linux-3.4.x/include/linux/pkt_sched.h $R/linux-3.4.x/include/linux/pkt_sched.h

        KC=$R/configs/boards/NEWIFI3/kernel-3.4.x.config
        sed -i '/^CONFIG_NET_SCH_CAKE=/d; /CONFIG_NET_SCH_CAKE is not set/d' $KC
        echo "CONFIG_NET_SCH_CAKE=y" >> $KC
        for o in NET_SCHED NET_CLS NET_CLS_ACT NET_ACT_MIRRED NET_CLS_U32 NET_SCH_INGRESS IFB; do
          sed -i "/^CONFIG_$o=/d; /^# CONFIG_$o is not set/d" $KC
          echo "CONFIG_$o=y" >> $KC
        done
        sed -i "/^CONFIG_NET_SCH_FQ_CODEL=/d; /^# CONFIG_NET_SCH_FQ_CODEL is not set/d" $KC
        echo "# CONFIG_NET_SCH_FQ_CODEL is not set" >> $KC

        TCP=/opt/rt-n56u/toolchain-mipsel/toolchain-3.4.x/bin/mipsel-linux-uclibc-
        cp -f $KC $R/linux-3.4.x/.config
        yes "" | make -C $R/linux-3.4.x ARCH=mips CROSS_COMPILE=$TCP oldconfig > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
        cp -f $R/linux-3.4.x/.config $KC

        rm -rf $R/user/iproute2
        cp -rf $T/user/iproute2 $R/user/iproute2

        python3 - <<'PYEOF'
        p = "/opt/rt-n56u/trunk/user/iproute2/iproute2-5.12.0/lib/fs.c"
        s = open(p).read()
        if "FS_COMPAT_UCLIBC" not in s:
            compat = (
                "\n/* FS_COMPAT_UCLIBC */\n"
                "#include <sys/syscall.h>\n#include <unistd.h>\n#include <fcntl.h>\n"
                "#ifndef __NR_name_to_handle_at\n#define __NR_name_to_handle_at 4339\n#endif\n"
                "#ifndef __NR_open_by_handle_at\n#define __NR_open_by_handle_at 4340\n#endif\n"
                "struct file_handle { unsigned int handle_bytes; int handle_type; unsigned char f_handle[]; };\n"
                "static int name_to_handle_at(int d, const char *n, struct file_handle *h, int *m, int f)\n"
                "{ return syscall(__NR_name_to_handle_at, d, n, h, m, f); }\n"
                "static int open_by_handle_at(int m, struct file_handle *h, int f)\n"
                "{ return syscall(__NR_open_by_handle_at, m, h, f); }\n\n"
            )
            i = s.rindex("#include")
            s = s[:s.find("\n", i)+1] + compat + s[s.find("\n", i)+1:]
            open(p, "w").write(s)
        PYEOF

        P=$(find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" -name patch_cake_backend.py -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -n1)
        [ -n "$P" ] && python3 "$P" $R

    - name: Download and Embed sing-box & AdGuardHome into ROM
      run: |
        set -e
        ROMFS_BIN="/opt/rt-n56u/trunk/user/romfs/usr/bin"
        mkdir -p "$ROMFS_BIN"

        echo "=== 1. Tải và nhúng sing-box-lite (v1.14.3) ==="
        mkdir -p /tmp/sb_dl
        curl -Lksf --retry 3 "https://github.com/MANCrimSon/sing-box-extended-lite/releases/download/v1.14.3-extended-2.7.3/sing-box-extended-lite-1.14.3-extended-2.7.3-linux-mipsle-softfloat-compressed.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C /tmp/sb_dl/
        SB_BIN=$(find /tmp/sb_dl/ -type f -name "sing-box*" | head -n1)
        mv -f "$SB_BIN" "$ROMFS_BIN/sing-box"
        chmod +x "$ROMFS_BIN/sing-box"
        rm -rf /tmp/sb_dl

        echo "=== 2. Tải và nén UPX AdGuardHome ==="
        mkdir -p /tmp/agh_dl
        curl -Lksf --retry 3 "https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdGuardHome/releases/latest/download/AdGuardHome_linux_mipsle_softfloat.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C /tmp/agh_dl/
        AGH_BIN=$(find /tmp/agh_dl/ -type f -name "AdGuardHome" | head -n1)
        
        # Nén UPX AdGuardHome từ 35MB xuống còn ~10.5MB
        echo "Đang nén UPX AdGuardHome..."
        upx --lzma --best "$AGH_BIN" || true
        mv -f "$AGH_BIN" "$ROMFS_BIN/AdGuardHome"
        chmod +x "$ROMFS_BIN/AdGuardHome"
        rm -rf /tmp/agh_dl

        echo "=== Danh sách binary nhúng thành công vào ROM: ==="
        ls -lh "$ROMFS_BIN/sing-box" "$ROMFS_BIN/AdGuardHome"

    - name: Build Firmware
      env:
        TNAME: NEWIFI3
        KERNEL: 3.4
      run: |
        cd /opt/rt-n56u/trunk
        cp -f configs/templates/$TNAME.config .config
        sed -i 's/CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_OPENSSL_EXE=n/CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_OPENSSL_EXE=y/g' .config
        
        ######################################################################
        ### TỐI ƯU CẤU HÌNH .CONFIG ĐỂ KHÔNG TRÀN FLASH 32MB ###
        ######################################################################
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_CPU_900MHZ=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_CPU_SLEEP=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_IPV6=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_USB=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_FAT=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_EXFAT=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_EXT2=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_EXT3=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_EXT4=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_FUSE=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_ENABLE_SWAP=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_SERIAL=y" >> .config
        
        # Bật module phục vụ CAKE & sing-box TProxy
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_QOS=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_IMQ=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_IFB=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_IPSET=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_TUNSAFE=y" >> .config
        
        # Tắt các dịch vụ nặng không dùng để tiết kiệm Flash
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_CADDY=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_FFMPEG_NEW=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_TAILSCALE=n" >> .config  # Dùng Tailscale trong sing-box
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_TRANSMISSION=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_ARIA=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_MINIDLNA=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_FIREFLY=n" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_XUPNPD=n" >> .config
        
        # Tiện ích mạng cần thiết
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_CURL=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_OPENSSH=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_HTOP=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_NANO=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_IPERF3=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_TTYD=y" >> .config
        
        # Bật cờ WebUI cho CAKE, sing-box và AdGuardHome
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_SINGBOX=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_ADGUARDHOME=y" >> .config
        echo "CONFIG_FIRMWARE_INCLUDE_CAKE=y" >> .config
        
        ######################################################################
        sudo ./clear_tree
        sudo ./build_firmware_modify $TNAME 0
        sudo mv -f images/*.trx /opt/images/
        
        ##### KIỂM TRA ĐỘ VỪA VẶN CỦA FILE ROM TRONG PHÂN VÙNG FLASH 32MB
        FLASH=$((32 * 1024 * 1024))
        STORE=$((0x200000))     # Storage 2MB
        FWMAX=$((FLASH - 0x50000 - STORE)) # Phân vùng ROM tối đa ~29.7MB

        for f in /opt/images/*.trx; do
          SZ=$(stat -c %s "$f")
          echo "=========================================================="
          echo "Firmware $(basename "$f"): $SZ / $FWMAX byte ($((SZ * 100 / FWMAX))%)"
          echo "Còn trống an toàn: $((FWMAX - SZ)) byte"
          echo "=========================================================="
          if [ "$SZ" -gt "$FWMAX" ]; then
            echo "::error::Firmware lớn hơn phân vùng Flash ($SZ > $FWMAX). HỦY BUILD!"
            exit 1
          fi
        done
        
        cp -f .config /opt/images/${TNAME}.config
        echo "build_time=$(date '+%Y年%m月%d日%H:%M:%S' | jq -sRr @uri)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "tag=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Upload packages
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: NEWIFI3
        path: /opt/images

    - name: Release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        body: |
           > ### Firmware Newifi 3 D2 tích hợp sẵn CAKE SQM, sing-box & AdGuardHome
        tag_name: ${{ env.tag }}
        files: /opt/images/*
